title: Build highlighted text component
story: As a user, I want to see my writing with sensory phrases highlighted in different colors so that I can immediately see where I engaged each sense.
acceptance_criteria: A HighlightedText component accepts the original text and an array of { phrase, sense, startIndex, endIndex } annotations
Each sense is rendered with a distinct highlight color: sight, sound, smell, taste, touch, organic, kinesthetic
Overlapping annotations are handled gracefully (no crashes)
A color legend is displayed showing which color maps to which sense
Unit tests cover rendering with annotations and the no-annotation case
